heading: cyOther information about the claim
paragraphs: cyYou will now be asked some final questions about your claim, including:
bullets: cyto provide any other information about your reasons for possession
cywhether you intend to make a general application with this claim
cywhether you need any support to use this service or come to court
cywhich language you completed this claim in
afterBullets: cyYou will also be asked if you want to answer optional questions to make sure we’re treating everyone fairly.
cyYou can then review your answers and submit and pay for your claim.
